moments.text: Infrared view of cloud streaks with a crosshair and four bracket bars. The tilted view rolls level by 2.8 s, then holds on cloud bands.
A tiny dot appears at the inner end of the right crosshair arm, then creeps up and left over the crosshair centre.
The dot, now a small bright oval, speeds up-left toward the left tip of a bright cloud and merges with it at 11.0 s.
The view swings fast and the clouds blur past; at 11.7 s the footage restarts at slower speed from the level cloud view.
Slow replay: the dot appears right of the crosshair centre, creeps up-left, then darts to the bright cloud's left tip at 18.6 s.
The replay ends with the same fast swing and blurred clouds.
